title: The Wax Seal
intro: A plum envelope sealed in gold wax. Bismillah at the top, four celebrations from Aqiqah to Valima, and a place for guests to send duas.
included: Nikah and Valima as separate events, each with a map
Every event saved to the calendar in one tap
Duas from guests, delivered to WhatsApp
A link that greets each family by name
